runs.interface: Claude Code CLI 2.1.317 headless (claude -p), skill installed in a fresh project folder
runs.python: 3.12.13 venv with the skill's requirements.txt (OCR on)

recipe.project_folder: a new empty folder per sheet holding <sheet>.pdf and .claude/skills/pid-to-kg (a copy of the skill at the commit)
recipe.prompt:
Convert `<sheet>.pdf` into a knowledge graph. The P&ID is on page 1.

This is a non-interactive run: nobody can answer questions, so make the choice you would recommend and note it in your final report. Python 3.12 with the skill's packages is already installed and on PATH; run every script as `python -I <full path to the script>`, and do not install anything.
recipe.cli: claude -p PROMPT --model 'claude-opus-5-5[1m]' --max-turns 150 --setting-sources project --strict-mcp-config --permission-mode default --tools Read Write Edit Glob Grep Bash Skill --allowedTools Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill 'Bash(python -I:*)' 'Bash(ls:*)' --output-format stream-json --verbose
recipe.inputs: OPEN100 and TE PNGs saved as one-page PDFs at a declared 300 dpi (Pillow); Pahala pages 21 and 22 copied out of the public PDF
recipe.concurrency: up to four sheets at once, 2026-11-11

pid-to-kg (its own links).line_layers_reason: sheet 0: re-traced links differ from the twin's (195 differ); the layers would not describe the same lines
sheet 0: re-traced links differ from the twin's (78 differ); the layers would not describe the same lines

loops.ours: no loops: round 6 increment 3 (signal_to, controls, loops) is not built
